title: Chef's Quick Recipe
ingredients: Sauce: 30ml soy sauce, 15ml sesame oil, 15g honey
Aromatics: 2 cloves garlic minced, 15g ginger grated
Vegetables: 200g broccoli florets, 1 bell pepper sliced
steps: Combine soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl to form the sauce.
Rinse jasmine rice and cook with 300ml water in a medium pot over medium-low heat for 15 minutes.
Heat 15ml vegetable oil in a large skillet or 28cm pan over medium-high heat.
Add cubed chicken to the pan and cook for 6 minutes until golden brown on all sides.
Toss in broccoli and bell pepper, pour in the sauce, and simmer for 5 minutes until tender.
Serve hot over cooked jasmine rice.
